name: legacy_customers
description: Legacy CRM export. Every value arrives as a string (or null) — dates, phones, balances and flags are free-form text.

fields.name: cust_id
fields.description: Legacy customer id, e.g. C-0001. Unique within the export.

fields.name: full_name
fields.description: Display name. Mixed formats: 'First Last', 'LAST, First', all-caps.

fields.name: email_addr
fields.description: Primary e-mail address as typed by the operator. Not validated at source.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Free-form phone number, mixed national and international notation.

fields.name: dob
fields.description: Date of birth. Either YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country as free text: names, aliases or codes.

fields.name: signup_date
fields.description: Account creation date. Either YYYY-MM-DD or DD-Mon-YYYY (e.g. 04-Mar-2021).

fields.name: status_code
fields.description: Single-letter lifecycle code (A, I, S plus operator typos).

fields.name: balance_str
fields.description: Account balance as formatted text, e.g. '1,234.50' or '-250.00'. Currency is not recorded.

fields.name: marketing_opt_in
fields.description: Consent flag as text: Y/N/yes/no/1/0, sometimes blank.

fields.name: legacy_segment
fields.description: Legacy commercial segment: RETAIL, GOLD, PLATINUM, ENTERPRISE.
